office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting District Court Judge Kuljinder K. Dhillon, appointed in 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Sitting King County District Court judge appointed in 2021; previously a domestic violence victim advocate, public defender, and private defense attorney.
highlights: Appointed to King County District Court in 2021 [S1]
Presided over the Regional Domestic Violence Court for two years [S1]
Prior work as a victim advocate at the Prosecutor's Office, then as a public defender and private defense attorney [S1]
